body:
1. In mcp/server.mjs line 137, support MCP 2024-11-05 notification 'notifications/cancelled' (extracting params.requestId) alongside '$/cancel' before the request.id check.
2. In mcp/server.mjs line 248, fix fallback text on empty stdout/stderr: output || (code === 0 ? 'Executed successfully' : `Command failed with exit code ${code}`).

Verification: npm test && node test/mcp.test.mjs
title: Support notifications/cancelled in MCP server and fix empty output fallback text
